name: Curve DEX
description: Curve's AMM for stablecoins, pegged assets (StableSwap) and volatile pairs (Twocrypto/Tricrypto). Agents can swap through CurveRouterNG with an off-chain computed route, discover pools on-chain via MetaRegistry/AddressProvider, provide liquidity, stake LP in gauges for CRV, lock CRV as veCRV to vote and earn revenue, and use crvUSD/scrvUSD.

keyFunctions.description: Swap along a route of up to 5 Curve pools: (_route, _swap_params, _amount of _route[0] in its decimals, _expected = min output of the final token). Approve _route[0] to the router first; send ETH as msg.value when _route[0] is 0xEeee...EEeE. Returns the amount received. _route is address[11] = [tokenIn, pool1, token1, pool2, token2, ...] padded with zero addresses (up to 5 hops; native ETH = 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE). _swap_params is uint256[5][5], one row per hop = [i, j, swap_type, pool_type, n_coins] where i/j are coin indices in that pool (pool.coins(n) or MetaRegistry.get_coin_indices), swap_type 1=exchange, 2=exchange_underlying, 3=underlying via zap, 4=coin->LP (add_liquidity), 5=lending underlying->LP, 6=LP->coin (remove_liquidity_one_coin), 7=LP->lending underlying, 8=ETH/WETH/stETH-type wraps, 9=SNX; pool_type 1=stableswap, 2=twocrypto, 3=tricrypto, 4=LLAMMA; unused rows are zeros. Routes are computed off-chain: use Curve's JS library (@curvefi/api router, github.com/curvefi/curve-js, or curve-router-js) or build a one-hop route yourself from MetaRegistry.find_pools_for_coins + get_coin_indices.
Same with _pools (only needed for swap_type 3 zaps; zeros otherwise) and an explicit _receiver.
Quote output of the final token for _amount in (same route encoding). Use it to set _expected with slippage.
Quote with _pools for zap routes.
Required input for a desired final output (_out_amount); pass zero-filled _pools when not using zaps. Approximate for crypto pools.
Router version string.

Same interface as v1.2 (route/swap_params encoding identical). Still registered as 'Exchange Router' (ID 2) in the Ethereum AddressProvider; the docs list it as router-v1 and 0x45312ea0eFf7E09C83CBE249fa1d7598c4C8cd4e (v1.2) as router-v2. Approve _route[0] to whichever router you call.
Quote output for a route.
Required input for a desired output (_out_amount, _pools, _base_pools, _base_tokens).

Lock CRV (_value, 18 decimals) until _unlock_time (unix seconds, rounded down to whole weeks; 1 week to 4 years). Approve CRV to veCRV first. One lock per address; smart contracts must be whitelisted by the DAO (smart_wallet_checker).

Withdraw all CRV after the lock has expired. No early exit.
(amount int128, end) of a lock.

Allocate veCRV voting power to a gauge (_user_weight in basis points, 0-10000 across all your votes). Each gauge vote can be changed once every 10 days.
Gauge's share of weekly CRV emissions (1e18 = 100%).
Absolute gauge weight.

Claim the caller's weekly protocol revenue (paid in crvUSD) earned by veCRV. Revenue is distributed within 24 h after Thursday 00:00 UTC each week.

N = number of LLAMMA liquidation bands (4-50).
LLAMMA AMM for a collateral token.

offchainApis.name: Curve API
offchainApis.use: Pool lists with coins, balances, TVL, APYs and gauge data: e.g. /getPools/all/{blockchainId} (ethereum, arbitrum, base, ...), /getPoolList/{blockchainId}, /getAllGauges, /getVolumes/{blockchainId}, /getTokens/all/{blockchainId}. OpenAPI spec at https://api.curve.finance/v1/openapi.json. Use it to pick pools and coin indices for routes.

offchainApis.name: Curve Prices API
offchainApis.use: Pool metadata, OHLC, trades, volume, liquidity and LP positions, crvUSD markets: e.g. /v1/pools/{chain}/{address}, /v1/ohlc/{chain}/{address}, /v1/liquidity/{chain}/{user}/positions, /v1/crvusd/markets. OpenAPI spec at https://prices.curve.finance/feeds-docs/openapi.json.

offchainApis.name: Curve deployments JSON
offchainApis.use: Machine-readable list of every official Curve contract per chain (routers, registries, factories, gauges, tokens, crvUSD, LlamaLend).

actions.name: swap via router
actions.description: Swap any tokens through up to 5 Curve pools.
actions.how: Compute _route and _swap_params off-chain (Curve JS @curvefi/api router or curve-router-js), or for one hop: pool = MetaRegistry.find_pools_for_coins(tokenIn, tokenOut)[0]; (i, j, _) = MetaRegistry.get_coin_indices(pool, tokenIn, tokenOut); route = [tokenIn, pool, tokenOut, 0x0...]; params[0] = [i, j, 1, pool_type, n_coins]. Quote router.get_dy(route, params, amount); approve tokenIn to the router (Ethereum v1.2 0x45312ea0eFf7E09C83CBE249fa1d7598c4C8cd4e); router.exchange(route, params, amount, minOut).

actions.name: swap directly in a pool
actions.how: Find indices with pool.coins(n) or MetaRegistry.get_coin_indices; approve coin i to the pool; pool.exchange(i, j, dx, min_dy). Stableswap pools use int128 indices, Twocrypto/Tricrypto-NG use uint256.

actions.name: add liquidity
actions.description: Deposit coins into a pool for LP.
actions.how: Approve each coin to the pool; quote calc_token_amount(amounts, true); add_liquidity(amounts, minLP). Amount array length = n_coins (NG stableswap takes a dynamic array). Remove with remove_liquidity_one_coin(lp, i, min) after calc_withdraw_one_coin.

actions.name: stake LP for CRV
actions.how: gauge = MetaRegistry.get_gauge(pool); approve LP to gauge; gauge.deposit(amount). Claim CRV with Minter.mint(gauge); extra rewards with gauge.claim_rewards() on newer gauges.

actions.name: lock CRV (veCRV)
actions.description: Get voting power, boost and revenue.
actions.how: CRV.approve(veCRV, amt); veCRV.create_lock(amt, unlockTime up to now+4y). Vote with GaugeController.vote_for_gauge_weights(gauge, bps). Claim weekly crvUSD revenue with FeeDistributor.claim(). Withdraw only after expiry: veCRV.withdraw().

actions.name: save in scrvUSD
actions.how: crvUSD.approve(scrvUSD, amt); scrvUSD.deposit(amt, receiver); exit with redeem(shares, receiver, owner).

risks: July 30, 2023: a Vyper compiler bug (versions 0.2.15, 0.2.16, 0.3.0 had broken @nonreentrant locks) let attackers re-enter and drain several Curve pools compiled with those versions (tens of millions of USD lost; partly recovered). Current pool implementations use fixed compiler versions, but old pools and other Vyper contracts may still carry legacy code risk.
Depeg risk: in stable pools an LP ends up holding mostly the depegged asset if one coin loses its peg; losses can be permanent.

Permissionless factories: anyone can deploy pools with any token (including malicious or fee-on-transfer tokens). Only use pools whose coins you have verified; MetaRegistry/API listing is not an endorsement.
Volatile (Twocrypto/Tricrypto) pools have impermanent loss and re-pegging dynamics; quotes for multi-hop routes can move between quote and execution: always set _expected/min_dy.

Governance: the Curve DAO (veCRV) controls pool parameters, gauge additions and crvUSD markets; the Emergency DAO (5-of-9 multisig) can kill gauges and cancel parameter changes. The AddressProvider is administered by a Curve individual and its IDs can change, so verify addresses it returns.
veCRV locks cannot be withdrawn before expiry and are non-transferable. crvUSD loans in LLAMMA are soft-liquidated gradually and can be hard-liquidated if health drops below 0.
USDT (3pool coin 2) requires approve(0) before changing a non-zero allowance; 3pool's exchange returns no value.
notes: All addresses come from Curve's official deployments data (docs.curve.finance/deployments.json, rendered at docs.curve.finance/developer/deployments.md), except the 3pool/3Crv/3pool gauge (official curvefi/curve-contract GitHub README and pooldata.json) and the crvUSD/USDC pool (example pool in the official CurveRouterNG docs). Every Ethereum address and every L2 router/AddressProvider/MetaRegistry was checked for code on-chain; router versions were read on-chain (Ethereum 0x45312ea0... = 1.2.0, 0x16C6521D... = 1.1.0, all listed L2 routers = 1.1.0). Wiring checked: MetaRegistry.get_pool_from_lp_token(3Crv) = 3pool, get_gauge(3pool) = the listed gauge, scrvUSD.asset = crvUSD, ControllerFactory.stablecoin = crvUSD, crvUSD/USDC pool coins = [USDC, crvUSD]; the Ethereum AddressProvider IDs were enumerated on-chain. Signatures are from Sourcify-verified Vyper sources (router v1.2, MetaRegistry, factories, veCRV, GaugeController, Minter, FeeDistributor, ControllerFactory, 3pool, gauge, scrvUSD's Yearn V3 implementation, crvUSD/USDC pool implementation) and Curve docs (AddressProvider ABI, NG pool and LiquidityGaugeV6 signatures). Pools are not enumerated here: discover them with MetaRegistry.find_pools_for_coins / pool_list, the factories' pool_list, or the Curve API. CRV emissions are claimed via the Minter only on Ethereum; L2 gauges are child gauges (see docs.curve.finance/developer/gauges/xchain-gauges/). Not listed: L2 factories, CRV/crvUSD/scrvUSD token addresses on L2s and the ~25 other chains (all in deployments.json), LlamaLend v1/v2 contracts (separate DefiLlama entries), individual crvUSD controllers (get them from ControllerFactory), calc zaps, fee burners and DAO Aragon voting contracts. The AddressProvider ID 2 'Exchange Router' on Ethereum still points to router v1.1 while the deployments page also lists v1.2; both work with the same route encoding.
